column2: Current section contains the version history and changes performed for the current document

column3:
Changes:
Structured definition for all fields required to support EMDN code versioning including following fields:
FLD_EMDN.code, FLD_EMDN.term, FLD_EMDN.status, FLD_EMDN.version, FLD_EMDN.fromDate, FLD_EMDN.action
No changes. Aligned PG and PROD versions - use PROD.
Added previously missing fields for Legacy Devices: humanProductCheck,  medicinalProductCheck

Updated FLD-UDID-181 and FLD-UDID-181. Removed the note related to the implementation of manual linking.
NRD entity  is moved under a dedicated Data Dictionary (known as OCM).

Added NRD data dictionary.
Label update for FLD-UDID-178,FLD-UDID-291,FLD-UDID-136,FLD-UDID-293 to accommodate Master UDI-DI implementation.

Device substatus entity is being populated for a device that is referenced in FSCA report in the Vigilance module.
FLD-UDID-123 has been deleted from the DeviceSubStatus entity.
FLD-UDID-178 - indicates the UDI-DI code and the Master UDI-DI code. Only the label differ depending on the type of device.

Updated the description for the fields FLD-UDID-180 and FLD-UDID-331 related to the link between a regulation device and their coresponding legacy device. It is possible to manually create and delete manually created link  between related devices.
Updated label description for the FLD-UDID-137 and FLD-UDID141.
Updated clarification for the field FLD-UDID-265 that is conditional mandatory.
Added FLD-UDID-179 Trade name applicable field. Flag Indicating in the UI if the trade name is applicable for the device.

SS(C)P tab was removed from this Data Dictionary. The data about SS(C)P can be consulted in the Certificates Data Dictionary (SSCPs are managed by NBs in EUDAMED).
FLD-UDID-37 AR Comments was removed because it is not yet implemented (not MVP).
